```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)

# Define a consistent medical color palette for visual identity across all plots
ecg_palette <- c(
  "Normal" = "#4a4b4c",
  "Arrhythmia" = "#d73027",
  "Normal Reference" = "#b3b4b5",
  "QRS Complex" = "#4395b4"
)

# Setting a seed ensures that the 'random' selections are the same every time
set.seed(20)
zip_path <- "../data/mitbih_test.zip"
```

```{r}
#| label: global-preprocessing
#| message: false

# Load and basic clean
ecg_raw <- read_csv(unz(zip_path, "mitbih_test.csv"), col_names = FALSE)
colnames(ecg_raw) <- c(paste0("t", 1:(ncol(ecg_raw) - 1)), "label")

# Create a clean, tidy long-format dataset
ecg_tidy <- ecg_raw %>% 
  mutate(
    sample_id = row_number(),
    label_name = case_when(
      label == 0 ~ "Normal",
      label == 1 ~ "Supraventricular",
      label == 2 ~ "Ventricular",
      label == 3 ~ "Fusion",
      label == 4 ~ "Unclassified",
      TRUE ~ as.character(label)
    ),
    color_group = ifelse(label == 0, "Normal", "Arrhythmia")
  ) 

ecg_long <- ecg_tidy %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("t"),
    names_to = "time",
    values_to = "amplitude",
  ) %>% 
  mutate(time = as.numeric(str_remove(time, "t")))

# Summary stats for confidence ribbons
ecg_stats <- ecg_long %>% 
  group_by(label_name, color_group, time) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_amp = mean(amplitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_amp = sd(amplitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Summary stats only for arrhythmia classes
arrhythmia_stats <- ecg_stats %>% 
  filter(label_name != "Normal")

# Extract a single reference baseline (Normal)
first_normal_id <- ecg_tidy %>% 
  filter(label == 0) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  pull(sample_id)

normal_baseline <- ecg_long %>% 
  filter(sample_id == first_normal_id) %>%
  select(time, baseline_amp = amplitude)

# Randomly select id for representative sample of each arrhythmia class
selected_ids <- ecg_long %>% 
  filter(label != 0) %>% 
  distinct(sample_id, label_name) %>% 
  group_by(label_name) %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 1) %>% 
  pull(sample_id)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-representative
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 8

# Build data for plot
plot_data_rep <- ecg_long %>% 
  filter(sample_id %in% selected_ids) %>% 
  left_join(normal_baseline, by = "time") %>% 
  arrange(label_name, time)

ggplot(plot_data_rep, aes(x = time)) +
  # Background reference
  geom_line(aes(y = baseline_amp, color = "Normal Reference", group = 1), linetype = "dashed") +
  # Main signal
  geom_line(aes(y = amplitude, color = color_group, group = 1), linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ label_name, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = ecg_palette) +
  labs(
    title = "Individual Arrhythmia Heartbeat Samples",
    subtitle = "Single-sample morphology comparison against a healthy reference",
    x = "Normalized Time Index (t)",
    y = "Voltage Amplitude (mV)",
    color = "Clinical Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-statistical-analysis
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 8

ggplot(pathology_stats, aes(x = time)) +
  # Range of variability (ribbon)
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_amp - sd_amp,
                  ymax = mean_amp + sd_amp,
                  fill = color_group),
              alpha = 0.15
                  ) +
  # Main line
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_amp, color = color_group),
            linewidth = 1) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ label_name, ncol = 1, scales= "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = ecg_palette) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ecg_palette) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) + 
  labs(
    title = "Statistical Class Morphology Analysys",
    subtitle = "Aggregated mean waveforms with +/- 1 standard deviation confidence ribbons",
    x = "Normalized Time Index (t)",
    y = "Voltage Amplitude (mV)",
    color = "Clinical Status",
    fill = "Clinical Status"
  ) +
  
  # Styling the plot
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  )
  
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-QRS
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 8

tech_sample_plot <- normal_baseline  %>% 
  mutate(type = case_when(
    (time <= 10) | (time >= 98 & time <= 110) ~ "QRS Complex",
    TRUE ~ "Normal ECG Signal"
  ))

ggplot(tech_sample_plot, aes(x = time, y = baseline_amp, group = 1)) +
  # Normal ecg signal
  geom_line(aes(color = type, alpha = type), linewidth = 1.1) +
  # Annotations for R-R interval
  annotate("segment", x = 5, xend = 100, y = 0.75, yend = 0.75,
           colour = "#4a4b4c", linewidth = 0.8,
           arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), ends = "both")) +
  annotate("text", x = 50, y = 0.8, label = "R-R Interval", size = 3.5, color = "#4a4b4c") +
  # Manual parameter setting
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "QRS Complex" = unname(ecg_palette["QRS Complex"]),
    "Normal ECG Signal" = unname(ecg_palette["Normal"])
  )) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(
    "QRS Complex" = 1,
    "Normal ECG Signal" = 0.3    
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Signal anatomy",
    subtitle = "Highlighting QRS complexes",
    x = "Normalized Time Index (t)",
    y = "Voltage Amplitude",
    color = "Segment Type:",
    alpha = "Segment Type:"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  )
```
